addons.name: Cry of Fear Glock
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua (model and sounds: Team Psykskallar, Cry of Fear)
addons.description: Glock 19 with slide lock, empty reloads and iron sights. Models and sounds are inside this addon. Requires Half-Life: Lua addon asset mounting. !give weapon_cof_glock

addons.name: Cry of Fear vehicle pack
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: Aud, Vari, Foretag, police car and fire engine, with matching physical wheels. Imports models from your local Cry of Fear installation.

addons.name: Fieldrunner utility van
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: An original six-seat van with a detailed cabin, custom wheels, suspension, running and brake lamps, and a two-tone horn.

addons.name: Example: graphics mod (colour grading)
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: A GLSL post-processing shader: colour grading, vignette, sharpening and depth haze, with settings in lua_settings. Copy it to start your own graphics mod.

addons.name: Example: custom HUD and menu
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: A Lua HUD (health, armor, ammo, names over heads) and a menu window. Type example_hud 1 and example_menu in the console.

addons.name: Example: shared library
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: Shows how one addon provides functions that other addons use (see example_uses_library).

addons.name: Example: movement abilities
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: Double jump, wall jump and higher jumps (predicted, no stutter). Type example_movement 1 in the console.

addons.name: Example: client Lua and net
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: A welcome message from the server, example_ping (round trip time), and a kill counter kept with networked variables.

addons.name: Example: scripted entity and weapons
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: sent_health_orb (a floating health pickup), weapon_lua_smg and weapon_lua_scattergun, all in Lua. Try !spawn sent_health_orb or !give weapon_lua_smg.

addons.name: Example: uses a library
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: Uses ExampleLibrary from example_library. Type example_hello in the console.

addons.name: First-person body
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: See your own body and legs in first person: walks, runs, crouches, jumps and turns in place, with the head hidden and the arms hidden while you hold a weapon. Settings in lua_settings.

addons.name: Half-Life 2 flashlight
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: Replaces the flashlight's round glow with a Half-Life 2 style spotlight: a sharp cone with a bright centre and soft rings, shading that follows the surfaces, shadows, distance falloff and a slight lag as you turn. Settings in lua_settings.

addons.name: Lua tank base
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: A base for tracked vehicles: raycast suspension on every road wheel, skid steering and pivot turns on a native rigid body, a turret and gun that follow your aim, moving tread links, driver and gunner seats, main and coaxial guns, armour, and a pop-top wreck. Tanks are separate addons.

addons.name: Meadow Tower: Night
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: A night version of Meadow Tower: night sky and moonlight, a lit tower with deck lanterns, beam lamps and floodlights, brighter path lamps, and crickets and wind. The elevator, bunker, HEV station, observation room and secret level all work. Start a game > meadow_tower_night.

addons.name: Realistic Graphics
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: One screen shader for a more modern look: ambient occlusion, weapon contact shadows, sun rays, bloom, fog and filmic colour, with presets and quality levels.

addons.name: GoldSrc Sandbox
addons.author: Half-Life: Lua
addons.description: 89 physical props, material impacts, destructibles, explosive drums, ammo pickups, car sounds and crash explosions, physgun cars, NPC barriers, thrusters, motors, construction saves/dupes. Host enables sandbox.
